headline: SAAM Reports Lower Earnings on Higher Fuel Costs
summary: SAAM reported a 6% year-on-year drop in net profit to $60.4 million for the first nine months of the year, impacted by higher operating costs amid rising fuel prices.
why: Port and logistics operators are vulnerable to fuel price inflation that compresses operating margins.

impacts.name: SAAM SA
impacts.why: Higher fuel expenses directly increase operating costs and reduce net profit margins.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
